name: sidar_adept
description: a Sidar Adept (Fall from Heaven), a pale washed-out grey mage: a ragged ash-grey hooded robe with tattered sleeves and a torn hem, pale silver hair under the hood, a teal sash, a brown leather satchel on a strap across the chest at his screen-left hip, grey boots, and a pale crooked wooden staff topped with a silver crescent moon around a glowing white orb with small white sparkles, held in his LEFT hand
hands: the crescent-moon staff stays upright in his left hand on the screen-right side and his right hand on the screen-left side is an empty fist resting on the satchel strap

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (his empty right fist flung out to the left, the crescent-moon staff thrown up and out in his left hand), the grey hood jolting back
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the crescent-moon staff tilting back, his empty right fist still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, body thrown back, staff arm flung up holding the crescent-moon staff high, his empty right fist drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, hooded head droops, the crescent-moon staff lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the crescent-moon end of the staff resting on the ground, his empty right hand hanging by the satchel
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the crescent-moon staff slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, the ragged robe flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, the grey hood still on his head; the crescent-moon staff lies on the ground at the lower-right, its orb dimmed; the satchel lies flat beside him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the ragged grey robe settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the grey hood on his head, the crescent-moon staff on the ground beside him
